title: Emerging roles of suppressor of cytokine signaling 3 in human cancers.
authors: Dai, Lirui; Li, Zian; Tao, Yiran; Liang, Wulong; Hu, Weihua; Zhou, Shaolong; Fu, Xudong; Wang, Xinjun
one_liner_zh: 综述SOCS3在人类癌症中的作用机制，涉及JAK/STAT信号通路和miRNA调控，但未涉及蛋白质-DNA互作、转录因子结合或AI/物理模拟方法，与本课题无关。
abstract: As a member of the suppressor of cytokine signaling (SOCS) family, SOCS3 is a cytokine-inducible protein that inhibits cytokine signaling in a variety of signaling pathways. Increasing evidence shows that SOCS3 regulates tumor development through multiple pathological and physiological processes. It is worth mentioning that SOCS3 negatively regulates JAK/STAT signaling by binding to JAK/cytokine receptors or phosphorylation docking sites on STAT receptors, thus preventing tumor cell proliferation and inhibiting tumor cell invasion and metastasis. The kinase inhibitory region KIR of SOCS3 is the key to JAK inhibition. In addition, SOCS3 may also regulate tumor progression through other molecules or signaling pathways, such as microRNAs (miRNAs), IL-6 and NF-kappaB signaling pathway. MicroRNAs inhibit SOCS3 expression by binding to the 3' untranslated region of SOCS3 mRNA, thus regulating tumor development processes, including tumor cell proliferation, invasion, metastasis, differentiation, cell cycle and apoptosis, as well as tumor metastasis and chemotherapy resistance. On the whole, SOCS3 acts as an inhibitor of the majority of tumors through various pathways. In the present review, the role of SOCS3 in multitudinous tumors was comprehensively summarized, the molecular mechanisms and modes of action of SOCS3 in tumors were discussed, and the association between SOCS3 expression and the clinical characteristics of patients with cancer were emphasized.
abstract_zh: 作为细胞因子信号传导抑制因子（SOCS）家族的一员，SOCS3是一种细胞因子诱导的蛋白质，通过多种信号通路抑制细胞因子信号传导。越来越多的证据表明，SOCS3通过多种病理生理过程调控肿瘤发展。值得一提的是，SOCS3通过结合JAK/细胞因子受体或STAT受体上的磷酸化对接位点，负向调节JAK/STAT信号传导，从而阻止肿瘤细胞增殖并抑制肿瘤细胞侵袭和转移。SOCS3的激酶抑制区KIR是抑制JAK的关键。此外，SOCS3还可能通过其他分子或信号通路调节肿瘤进展，如微小RNA（miRNAs）、IL-6和NF-kappaB信号通路。微小RNA通过结合SOCS3 mRNA的3'非翻译区抑制SOCS3表达，从而调节肿瘤发展过程，包括肿瘤细胞增殖、侵袭、转移、分化、细胞周期和凋亡，以及肿瘤转移和化疗耐药性。总体而言，SOCS3通过多种途径作为大多数肿瘤的抑制剂。在本综述中，全面总结了SOCS3在多种肿瘤中的作用，探讨了SOCS3在肿瘤中的分子机制和作用方式，并强调了SOCS3表达与癌症患者临床特征之间的关联。
